list.description: Lists all the feedback for an alert. Attempting to list feedbacks for a non-existent alert returns `NOT_FOUND` error.

[Find your customer ID](https://support.google.com/cloudidentity/answer/10070793).

create.description: Creates new feedback for an alert. Attempting to create a feedback for a non-existent alert returns `NOT_FOUND` error. Attempting to create a feedback for an alert that is marked for deletion returns `FAILED_PRECONDITION' error.

undelete.description: Restores, or "undeletes", an alert that was marked for deletion within the past 30 days. Attempting to undelete an alert which was marked for deletion over 30 days ago (which has been removed from the Alert Center database) or a nonexistent alert returns a `NOT_FOUND` error. Attempting to undelete an alert which has not been marked for deletion has no effect.

alertId.description: Required. The identifier of the alert to undelete.

batchDelete.description: Performs batch delete operation on alerts.

delete.description: Marks the specified alert for deletion. An alert that has been marked for deletion is removed from Alert Center after 30 days. Marking an alert for deletion has no effect on an alert which has already been marked for deletion. Attempting to mark a nonexistent alert for deletion results in a `NOT_FOUND` error.

domain.description: Customer domain for email template personalization.

attachmentData.description: Optional. Application-specific data for an incident, provided when the Google Workspace application which reported the incident cannot be completely restored to a valid state.

GoogleOperations.description: An incident reported by Google Operations for a Google Workspace application.

AccessApproval.description: Alert that is triggered when Google support requests to access customer data.

requestId.description: ID of the Access Approvals request. This is a helpful field when requesting support from Google.

scope.description: Scope of access, also known as a resource. This is further narrowed down by the product field.

justificationReason.description: Justification for data access based on justification enums.

products.description: Products within scope of the Access Approvals request.

tickets.description: Support tickets related to this Access Approvals request. Populated if there is an associated case number.

officeLocation.description: Office location of Google staff requesting access such as "US".

ruleViolationInfo.description: Details about the violated DLP rule. Admins can use the predefined detectors provided by Google Cloud DLP https://cloud.google.com/dlp/ when setting up a DLP rule. Matched Cloud DLP detectors in this violation if any will be captured in the MatchInfo.predefined_detector.

DlpRuleViolation.description: Alerts that get triggered on violations of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules.

events.description: Required. The list of security events.

email.description: The email of the user this alert was created for.

SuspiciousActivity.description: A mobile suspicious activity alert. Derived from audit logs.

ListAlertFeedbackResponse.description: Response message for an alert feedback listing request.

feedback.description: The list of alert feedback. Feedback entries for each alert are ordered by creation time descending.

email.description: The email of the user this incident was created for.

StateSponsoredAttack.description: A state-sponsored attack alert. Derived from audit logs.

DomainWideTakeoutInitiated.description: A takeout operation for the entire domain was initiated by an admin. Derived from audit logs.

email.description: The email of the admin who initiated the takeout.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the device.

iosVendorId.description: Required for iOS, empty for others.

deviceCompromisedState.description: The device compromised state. Possible values are "`Compromised`" or "`Not Compromised`".

DeviceCompromisedSecurityDetail.description: Detailed information of a single MDM device compromised event.

RuleViolationInfo.description: Common alert information about violated rules that are configured by Google Workspace administrators.

agentType.description: Optional. Agent type that triggered the rule.

triggeredActionInfo.description: Metadata related to the triggered actions.

recipients.description: Resource recipients. For Drive, they are grantees that the Drive file was shared with at the time of rule triggering. Valid values include user emails, group emails, domains, or 'anyone' if the file was publicly accessible. If the file was private the recipients list will be empty. For Gmail, they are emails of the users or groups that the Gmail message was sent to.

resourceInfo.description: Details of the resource which violated the rule.

matchInfo.description: List of matches that were found in the resource content.

suppressedActionTypes.description: Actions suppressed due to other actions with higher priority.

Warn end user about Chat content.

triggeredActionTypes.description: Actions applied as a consequence of the rule being triggered.

triggeringUserEmail.description: Email of the user who caused the violation. Value could be empty if not applicable, for example, a violation found by drive continuous scan.

enumDescriptions: A file being downloaded in a Chrome browser.
A file being uploaded from a Chrome browser.
Web content being uploaded from a Chrome browser.
A page is being printed by Chrome.
A URL is visited within Chrome.
A file being transferred (copy or moved) between different file systems on ChromeOS.

eventType.description: Event associated with this alert after applying the rule.

IdentityProviderError.description: Error related to an identity provider.

authorizationBaseUrl.description: Authorization base url of the identity provider.

enumDescriptions: Email in the ID token is different from the user's email.
Discovery URL did not contain all the necessary information.
URL for client-side encryption configuration content was unreachable.
Client-side encryption .well-known URL did not contain all the necessary information.
ID token returned by the identity provider is invalid.
Authentication token has no "email" or "google_email" claim.
errorInfo.description: Info on the identity provider error.
